Name: Bug Meat Vats(Remake)
Author: Nymphiapkm
Description:
Adds Bug meat Vats that grow 5-8 Bug meat every other day
Changes from the original mod(other than the obvious) \/
[spoiler]Bug Meat vats are no longer sold at Robins, instead you unlock their crafting recipe at Combat lv4
You craft Bug meat vats with 10 Iron bars, 25 Bug meat, a Battery pack, & 5 Refined quartz[/spoiler]
Currently planned but not implemented features
Bug meat vats having a rare chance of giving a Green Slime egg
Bug meat vats having a rare chance of failing and giving 5-8 Slime instead
Buggy Delights(wip name), A recipe book with 6 bug meat recipes

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10508]Based on Meat Vat Farm Cave[/url], a mod that's currently broken in 1.6[/b]
(I'm not planning on adding the cave type from the og mod)
